name: ueviewer-asset-bridge
description: Read-only UEViewer wrapper that emits one self-contained glTF evidence HTML package.

scripts.build:sample: node src/bridge.mjs build --game-dir fixtures/AuthorizedGame --package SamplePackage.upk --gltf fixtures/triangle.gltf --object SampleTriangle --output artifacts/sample-evidence.html --acknowledge-read-only I_OWN_OR_AM_AUTHORIZED --no-open
